      const [onboarded, setOnboarded] = useState(false);
      const [userName, setUserName] = useState('Alex Chen');
      const [githubId, setGithubId] = useState('octocat');
      const [companionGender, setCompanionGender] = useState('female'); // 'female' | 'male' | 'neutral'
      
      const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('dashboard'); // 'dashboard' | 'pomodoro' | 'calendar' | 'github' | 'settings'
      const [companionPose, setCompanionPose] = useState('wave'); // 'wave' | 'work' | 'urgent' | 'idle'
      const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState(true);
      
      // GitHub live data state via MCP
      const [githubData, setGithubData] = useState(null);
      const [githubLoading, setGithubLoading] = useState(false);
      const [githubError, setGithubError] = useState(null);

      // PRs state
      const [prs, setPrs] = useState([
        { id: 104, title: 'Fix Authentication Token Expiration', status: 'Review Requested', priority: 'High', repo: 'core-api' },
        { id: 108, title: 'Upgrade Three.js Canvas Engine', status: 'Approved', priority: 'Medium', repo: 'aura-ui' },
        { id: 112, title: 'Glassmorphic Theme Adjustments', status: 'Merged', priority: 'Low', repo: 'aura-ui' }
      ]);

      // To-Do list state
      const [todos, setTodos] = useState([
        { id: 1, text: 'Review PR #104 security patch', priority: 'High', pomos: 2, completed: false },
        { id: 2, text: 'Refactor Three.js lighting & shaders', priority: 'Medium', pomos: 3, completed: false },
        { id: 3, text: 'Update glassmorphic card borders', priority: 'Low', pomos: 1, completed: true },
        { id: 4, text: 'Prepare weekly engineering sprint summary', priority: 'High', pomos: 2, completed: false }
      ]);
      const [newTodoText, setNewTodoText] = useState('');
      const [newTodoPriority, setNewTodoPriority] = useState('Medium');
      const [newTodoPomos, setNewTodoPomos] = useState(2);

      // Calendar & Deadlines state
      const [deadlines, setDeadlines] = useState([
        { id: 1, title: 'Core API v2 Security Audit', type: 'Submission', time: new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 60 * 60 * 18).toISOString() },
        { id: 2, title: 'Engineering Sprint Review & Demo', type: 'Meeting', time: new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 60 * 60 * 42).toISOString() },
        { id: 3, title: 'Q3 Architectural Roadmap Finalization', type: 'Milestone', time: new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 60 * 60 * 96).toISOString() }
      ]);
      const [newDeadlineTitle, setNewDeadlineTitle] = useState('');
      const [newDeadlineType, setNewDeadlineType] = useState('Submission');
      const [newDeadlineHours, setNewDeadlineHours] = useState('24');

      // Pomodoro state
      const [pomoTime, setPomoTime] = useState(25 * 60);
      const [pomoRunning, setPomoRunning] = useState(false);
      const [pomoMode, setPomoMode] = useState('focus'); // 'focus' | 'break' | 'longbreak'

      // Check for urgent deadlines (< 2 hours) to trigger companion 'urgent' pose
      useEffect(() => {
        const checkUrgent = deadlines.some(d => {
          const diff = new Date(d.time).getTime() - Date.now();
          return diff > 0 && diff < 1000 * 60 * 120; // less than 2 hours
        });
        if (checkUrgent && !pomoRunning) {
          setCompanionPose('urgent');
        }
      }, [deadlines, pomoRunning]);

      // Fetch GitHub data via MCP
      const fetchGithubProfile = async (queryUser) => {
        setGithubLoading(true);
        setGithubError(null);
        try {
          const result = await archestra.tools.call('github__search_repositories', {
            query: `user:${queryUser}`
          });
          setGithubData(result);
        } catch (err) {
          if (err && err.code === 'auth_required') {
            setGithubError(err);
          } else {
            setGithubError({ message: err.message || 'Failed to fetch GitHub data' });
          }
        } finally {
          setGithubLoading(false);
        }
      };

      useEffect(() => {
        if (onboarded && githubId) {
          fetchGithubProfile(githubId);
        }
      }, [onboarded, githubId]);

      // Determine active mode
      const mode = useMemo(() => {
        if (pomoRunning) return 'hectic';
        const hasHigh = prs.some(p => p.priority === 'High' && p.status !== 'Merged');
        const allGreen = prs.every(p => p.status === 'Merged' || p.status === 'Approved');
        if (allGreen && todos.length > 0 && todos.every(t => t.completed)) return 'party';
        if (hasHigh) return 'hectic';
        return 'normal';
      }, [prs, todos, pomoRunning]);

      // Pomodoro interval
      useEffect(() => {
        let interval = null;
        if (pomoRunning && pomoTime > 0) {
          interval = setInterval(() => {
            setPomoTime(t => t - 1);
          }, 1000);
        } else if (pomoTime === 0) {
          setPomoRunning(false);
          if (typeof confetti === 'function') {
            confetti({ particleCount: 120, spread: 80, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
          }
        }
        return () => clearInterval(interval);
      }, [pomoRunning, pomoTime]);

      // Sync companion pose when Pomodoro is running
      useEffect(() => {
        if (pomoRunning) {
          setCompanionPose('work');
        } else {
          setCompanionPose('wave');
        }
      }, [pomoRunning]);

      const handleToggleTodo = (id) => {
        setTodos(prev => {
          const next = prev.map(t => t.id === id ? { ...t, completed: !t.completed } : t);
          const allDone = next.length > 0 && next.every(t => t.completed);
          if (allDone && typeof confetti === 'function') {
            confetti({ particleCount: 180, spread: 100, origin: { y: 0.5 } });
          }
          return next;
        });
      };

      const handleAddTodo = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!newTodoText.trim()) return;
        setTodos(prev => [...prev, { 
          id: Date.now(), 
          text: newTodoText.trim(), 
          priority: newTodoPriority, 
          pomos: Number(newTodoPomos) || 1, 
          completed: false 
        }]);
        setNewTodoText('');
      };

      const handleDeleteTodo = (id) => {
        setTodos(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== id));
      };

      const handleUpdatePrStatus = (id, newStatus) => {
        setPrs(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status: newStatus } : p));
      };

      const handleAddDeadline = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!newDeadlineTitle.trim()) return;
        const targetTime = new Date(Date.now() + Number(newDeadlineHours) * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
        setDeadlines(prev => [...prev, { id: Date.now(), title: newDeadlineTitle.trim(), type: newDeadlineType, time: targetTime }]);
        setNewDeadlineTitle('');
      };

      const handleDeleteDeadline = (id) => {
        setDeadlines(prev => prev.filter(d => d.id !== id));
      };

      // Onboarding & Character Selection Modal with dark cards and glowing neon borders
      if (!onboarded) {
        return (
          <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <div className="max-w-xl w-full bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/15 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-2xl flex flex-col gap-6">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                  <span className="font-black text-2xl text-white">Ω</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h1 className="font-extrabold text-xl text-white tracking-wide">
                    Aura 3D Companion Studio
                  </h1>
                  <p className="text-xs text-indigo-300">Initialize your personalized WebGL focus assistant</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setOnboarded(true); }} className="flex flex-col gap-5">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                    <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200 uppercase tracking-wider">Your Name</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={userName}
                      onChange={(e) => setUserName(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g. Alex Chen"
                      className="bg-slate-950 border border-white/20 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white placeholder-slate-500 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                    <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200 uppercase tracking-wider">GitHub ID / Username</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={githubId}
                      onChange={(e) => setGithubId(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g. octocat"
                      className="bg-slate-950 border border-white/20 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white placeholder-slate-500 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                  <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200 uppercase tracking-wider">Select Avatar Style & Personality</label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setCompanionGender('female')}
                      className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border text-left flex flex-col gap-1 transition-all ${
                        companionGender === 'female' 
                          ? 'bg-slate-900 border-rose-500 shadow-lg shadow-rose-500/40 ring-2 ring-rose-500/50 scale-[1.02]' 
                          : 'bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-700 hover:border-rose-400/60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white tracking-wide">Aura (Female)</span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-rose-400 font-medium">Rose Quartz & Warm Glow</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setCompanionGender('male')}
                      className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border text-left flex flex-col gap-1 transition-all ${
                        companionGender === 'male' 
                          ? 'bg-slate-900 border-sky-500 shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/40 ring-2 ring-sky-500/50 scale-[1.02]' 
                          : 'bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-700 hover:border-sky-400/60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white tracking-wide">Kaito (Male)</span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-sky-400 font-medium">Cyber Blue & Techware</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setCompanionGender('neutral')}
                      className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border text-left flex flex-col gap-1 transition-all ${
                        companionGender === 'neutral' 
                          ? 'bg-slate-900 border-purple-500 shadow-lg shadow-purple-500/40 ring-2 ring-purple-500/50 scale-[1.02]' 
                          : 'bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-700 hover:border-purple-400/60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white tracking-wide">Zenith (Neutral)</span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-purple-400 font-medium">Neon Violet & Minimal</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-slate-950/80 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-300 font-bold">
                      WebGL
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">Interactive 3D Preview Ready</h4>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-300">Suspense boundary with preloaded lighting & shaders</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping"></span>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="w-full mt-2 py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold text-sm shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/40 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Launch Aura Workspace →
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      }

      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-indigo-500 selection:text-white">
          {/* Header Navigation */}
          <header className="w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 pt-6 pb-4">
            <div className="bg-slate-900/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-2xl flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
              
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-2">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-600 via-purple-600 to-pink-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/30">
                  <span className="font-black text-xl tracking-wider text-white">Ω</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h1 className="font-bold text-lg tracking-wide bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-slate-200 to-indigo-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                    Aura Hub <span className="text-xs text-indigo-400 font-normal">({userName})</span>
                  </h1>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">GitHub: @{githubId}</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <nav className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/60 p-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/5 flex-wrap justify-center">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('dashboard')}
                  className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
                    activeTab === 'dashboard'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/40 border border-indigo-400 scale-105'
                      : 'bg-slate-800/60 text-slate-300 border border-white/10 hover:bg-slate-700/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  Dashboard
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('pomodoro')}
                  className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
                    activeTab === 'pomodoro'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/40 border border-indigo-400 scale-105'
                      : 'bg-slate-800/60 text-slate-300 border border-white/10 hover:bg-slate-700/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  Pomodoro Studio
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('calendar')}
                  className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
                    activeTab === 'calendar'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/40 border border-indigo-400 scale-105'
                      : 'bg-slate-800/60 text-slate-300 border border-white/10 hover:bg-slate-700/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  Calendar & Deadlines
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('github')}
                  className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
                    activeTab === 'github'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/40 border border-indigo-400 scale-105'
                      : 'bg-slate-800/60 text-slate-300 border border-white/10 hover:bg-slate-700/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  GitHub MCP
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab('settings')}
                  className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
                    activeTab === 'settings'
                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/40 border border-indigo-400 scale-105'
                      : 'bg-slate-800/60 text-slate-300 border border-white/10 hover:bg-slate-700/60'
                  }`}
                >
                  Settings
                </button>
              </nav>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2">
                <div className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                  mode === 'normal'
                    ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/50 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20'
                    : 'bg-slate-800/40 text-slate-500 border border-white/5 opacity-60'
                }`}>
                  <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${mode === 'normal' ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-slate-600'}`}></span>
                  Normal
                </div>
                <div className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                  mode === 'hectic'
                    ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/50 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20'
                    : 'bg-slate-800/40 text-slate-500 border border-white/5 opacity-60'
                }`}>
                  <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${mode === 'hectic' ? 'bg-amber-400 animate-ping' : 'bg-slate-600'}`}></span>
                  Hectic
                </div>
                <div className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                  mode === 'party'
                    ? 'bg-fuchsia-500/20 text-fuchsia-300 border border-fuchsia-500/50 shadow-lg shadow-fuchsia-500/20'
                    : 'bg-slate-800/40 text-slate-500 border border-white/5 opacity-60'
                }`}>
                  <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${mode === 'party' ? 'bg-fuchsia-400 animate-bounce' : 'bg-slate-600'}`}></span>
                  Party
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>
          </header>

          {/* Main Content Body */}
          <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 py-4">
            {activeTab === 'dashboard' && (
              <DashboardView 
                gender={companionGender}
                pose={companionPose}
                prs={prs}
                onUpdatePr={handleUpdatePrStatus}
                todos={todos}
                onToggleTodo={handleToggleTodo}
                onAddTodo={handleAddTodo}
                newTodoText={newTodoText}
                setNewTodoText={setNewTodoText}
                newTodoPriority={newTodoPriority}
                setNewTodoPriority={setNewTodoPriority}
                newTodoPomos={newTodoPomos}
                setNewTodoPomos={setNewTodoPomos}
                onDeleteTodo={handleDeleteTodo}
                pomoRunning={pomoRunning}
                setPomoRunning={setPomoRunning}
                pomoTime={pomoTime}
                setPomoTime={setPomoTime}
                githubData={githubData}
                githubLoading={githubLoading}
                githubError={githubError}
                userName={userName}
                githubId={githubId}
                deadlines={deadlines}
              />
            )}
            {activeTab === 'pomodoro' && (
              <PomodoroStudioView
                gender={companionGender}
                pose={companionPose}
                pomoRunning={pomoRunning}
                setPomoRunning={setPomoRunning}
                pomoTime={pomoTime}
                setPomoTime={setPomoTime}
                pomoMode={pomoMode}
                setPomoMode={setPomoMode}
                todos={todos}
                onToggleTodo={handleToggleTodo}
                onDeleteTodo={handleDeleteTodo}
                onAddTodo={handleAddTodo}
                newTodoText={newTodoText}
                setNewTodoText={setNewTodoText}
                newTodoPriority={newTodoPriority}
                setNewTodoPriority={setNewTodoPriority}
                newTodoPomos={newTodoPomos}
                setNewTodoPomos={setNewTodoPomos}
              />
            )}
            {activeTab === 'calendar' && (
              <CalendarDeadlineView
                deadlines={deadlines}
                onAddDeadline={handleAddDeadline}
                onDeleteDeadline={handleDeleteDeadline}
                newDeadlineTitle={newDeadlineTitle}
                setNewDeadlineTitle={setNewDeadlineTitle}
                newDeadlineType={newDeadlineType}
                setNewDeadlineType={setNewDeadlineType}
                newDeadlineHours={newDeadlineHours}
                setNewDeadlineHours={setNewDeadlineHours}
              />
            )}
            {activeTab === 'github' && (
              <GitHubMCPFeedView
                githubId={githubId}
                githubData={githubData}
                githubLoading={githubLoading}
                githubError={githubError}
                onRefresh={() => fetchGithubProfile(githubId)}
              />
            )}
            {activeTab === 'settings' && (
              <SettingsView
                gender={companionGender}
                setGender={setCompanionGender}
                userName={userName}
                setUserName={setUserName}
                githubId={githubId}
                setGithubId={setGithubId}
                soundEnabled={soundEnabled}
                setSoundEnabled={setSoundEnabled}
              />
            )}
          </main>
        </div>
      );
    }

    /* ----------------------------------------------------
       ROBUST THREE.JS CHIBI 3D AVATAR COMPONENT WITH SUSPENSE
       ---------------------------------------------------- */
    function ChibiAvatar({ gender = 'female', pose = 'wave' }) {
      const [isLoaded, setIsLoaded] = useState(false);
      const mountRef = useRef(null);

      useEffect(() => {
        const container = mountRef.current;
        if (!container) return;

        // Scene, Camera, Renderer setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.set(0, 1.2, 4.5);

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true });
        renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Preload lighting before rendering geometry
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xa5b4fc, 2.0);
        dirLight.position.set(5, 8, 5);
        scene.add(dirLight);

        const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(pose === 'urgent' ? 0xef4444 : 0xd946ef, 3.0, 12);
        pointLight.position.set(-3, 2, 2);
        scene.add(pointLight);

        const chibiGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(chibiGroup);

        // Materials with smooth shading
        const skinMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffe4e6, roughness: 0.4 });
        const hairMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
          color: gender === 'female' ? 0xf43f5e : gender === 'male' ? 0x38bdf8 : 0xa855f7, 
          roughness: 0.3 
        });
        const outfitMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1e293b, roughness: 0.3 });
        const collarMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.2 });
        const eyeMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0f172a, roughness: 0.1 });
        const laptopMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x475569, metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.2 });
        const screenMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: pose === 'urgent' ? 0xef4444 : 0x38bdf8 });
        const headphoneMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: pose === 'urgent' ? 0xef4444 : 0xf43f5e, metalness: 0.5 });

        // Head geometry
        const headGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.75, 32, 32);
        const head = new THREE.Mesh(headGeo, skinMat);
        head.position.set(0, 0.85, 0);
        chibiGroup.add(head);

        // Eyes
        const eyeGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1, 16, 16);
        const leftEye = new THREE.Mesh(eyeGeo, eyeMat);
        leftEye.position.set(0.22, 0.9, 0.62);
        chibiGroup.add(leftEye);

        const rightEye = new THREE.Mesh(eyeGeo, eyeMat);
        rightEye.position.set(-0.22, 0.9, 0.62);
        chibiGroup.add(rightEye);

        // Stylized Hair
        const hairBaseGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.8, 32, 32);
        const hairBase = new THREE.Mesh(hairBaseGeo, hairMat);
        hairBase.position.set(0, 0.95, -0.05);
        hairBase.scale.set(1.02, 1.05, 1.05);
        chibiGroup.add(hairBase);

        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
          const spikeGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.2, 0.4, 16);
          const spike = new THREE.Mesh(spikeGeo, hairMat);
          spike.rotation.x = Math.PI / 4;
          spike.position.set((i - 2) * 0.2, 1.45, 0.4 - Math.abs(i - 2) * 0.05);
          chibiGroup.add(spike);
        }

        // Torso
        const torsoGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35, 0.45, 0.9, 32);
        const torso = new THREE.Mesh(torsoGeo, outfitMat);
        torso.position.set(0, -0.05, 0);
        chibiGroup.add(torso);

        // Collar
        const collarGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 0.15, 0.4);
        const collar = new THREE.Mesh(collarGeo, collarMat);
        collar.position.set(0, 0.35, 0.1);
        chibiGroup.add(collar);

        // Arms
        const armGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.1, 0.1, 0.7, 16);
        const leftArm = new THREE.Mesh(armGeo, outfitMat);
        leftArm.position.set(0.55, 0.05, 0);
        leftArm.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 6;
        chibiGroup.add(leftArm);

        const rightArm = new THREE.Mesh(armGeo, outfitMat);
        rightArm.position.set(-0.55, 0.05, 0);
        chibiGroup.add(rightArm);

        // Headphones
        const headphoneGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const bandGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.82, 0.06, 16, 32, Math.PI);
        const band = new THREE.Mesh(bandGeo, headphoneMat);
        band.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        band.position.set(0, 1.1, 0);
        headphoneGroup.add(band);

        const cupGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.15, 0.15, 0.1, 16);
        const leftCup = new THREE.Mesh(cupGeo, headphoneMat);
        leftCup.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
        leftCup.position.set(0.78, 0.9, 0);
        headphoneGroup.add(leftCup);

        const rightCup = new THREE.Mesh(cupGeo, headphoneMat);
        rightCup.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
        rightCup.position.set(-0.78, 0.9, 0);
        headphoneGroup.add(rightCup);

        chibiGroup.add(headphoneGroup);
        headphoneGroup.visible = (pose === 'work' || pose === 'urgent');

        // Laptop
        const laptopGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const baseBoxGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.9, 0.05, 0.6);
        const laptopBase = new THREE.Mesh(baseBoxGeo, laptopMat);
        laptopBase.position.set(0, -0.4, 0.8);
        laptopBase.rotation.x = -0.1;
        laptopGroup.add(laptopBase);

        const screenBoxGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.9, 0.6, 0.05);
        const laptopScreen = new THREE.Mesh(screenBoxGeo, screenMat);
        laptopScreen.position.set(0, 0.05, 0.52);
        laptopScreen.rotation.x = -0.4;
        laptopGroup.add(laptopScreen);
        laptopGroup.position.set(0, -0.1, 0);
        scene.add(laptopGroup);
        laptopGroup.visible = (pose === 'work' || pose === 'urgent');

        setIsLoaded(true);

        let clock = new THREE.Clock();
        let animationFrameId;

        const animate = () => {
          animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          const elapsedTime = clock.getElapsedTime();

          chibiGroup.position.y = Math.sin(elapsedTime * 2) * 0.05;

          if (pose === 'wave') {
            rightArm.rotation.z = Math.PI / 3 + Math.sin(elapsedTime * 5) * 0.4;
            rightArm.rotation.x = Math.sin(elapsedTime * 3) * 0.2;
            head.rotation.y = Math.sin(elapsedTime * 1.5) * 0.15;
          } else if (pose === 'work') {
            rightArm.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 4 + Math.sin(elapsedTime * 12) * 0.1;
            leftArm.rotation.z = Math.PI / 4 + Math.cos(elapsedTime * 12) * 0.1;
            head.rotation.x = 0.2 + Math.sin(elapsedTime * 4) * 0.05;
            head.rotation.y = 0;
          } else if (pose === 'urgent') {
            rightArm.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 3 + Math.sin(elapsedTime * 15) * 0.5;
            head.rotation.z = Math.sin(elapsedTime * 10) * 0.2;
            chibiGroup.position.x = Math.sin(elapsedTime * 20) * 0.03;
          } else {
            rightArm.rotation.z = Math.PI / 6;
            leftArm.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 6;
            head.rotation.y = 0;
          }

          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        };

        animate();

        const handleResize = () => {
          if (!container) return;
          camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
          renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
        };
        window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

        return () => {
          window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
          cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
          if (container.contains(renderer.domElement)) {
            container.removeChild(renderer.domElement);
          }
          renderer.dispose();
        };
      }, [gender, pose]);

      return (
        <div className="h-[400px] w-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-900/50 border border-white/10 relative shadow-2xl flex flex-col">
          <div className="absolute top-3 left-4 z-10 flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-900/80 px-3 py-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-300">
            <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${pose === 'urgent' ? 'bg-red-400 animate-ping' : 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse'}`}></span>
            3D WebGL Engine Active ({gender}, {pose})
          </div>

          {!isLoaded && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 z-20">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-indigo-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono tracking-widest text-indigo-300">LOADING AURA 3D...</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <div ref={mountRef} className="flex-1 w-full h-full cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing" />
        </div>
      );
    }

    /* ----------------------------------------------------
       CONTRIBUTION HEATMAP COMPONENT
       ---------------------------------------------------- */
    function ContributionHeatmap({ githubData }) {
      const days = useMemo(() => {
        const arr = [];
        const today = new Date();
        for (let i = 83; i >= 0; i--) {
          const d = new Date(today);
          d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
          const count = Math.random() > 0.3 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) : 0;
          arr.push({ date: d.toDateString(), count });
        }
        return arr;
      }, [githubData]);

      const [tooltip, setTooltip] = useState(null);

      const getColorClass = (count) => {
        if (count === 0) return 'bg-slate-800/80 border-slate-700/50';
        if (count <= 2) return 'bg-cyan-500/40 border-cyan-400/40 shadow-cyan-500/20';
        if (count <= 4) return 'bg-indigo-600 border-indigo-500 shadow-indigo-600/40';
        return 'bg-purple-600 border-purple-400 shadow-purple-600/50';
      };

      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 relative">
          <div className="grid grid-flow-col grid-rows-7 gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
            {days.map((day, idx) => (
              <div
                key={idx}
                onMouseEnter={() => setTooltip(day)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setTooltip(null)}
                className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-sm border transition-all hover:scale-125 cursor-pointer ${getColorClass(day.count)}`}
              ></div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400 pt-1 border-t border-white/5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>Less</span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700"></span>
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm bg-cyan-500/40"></span>
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm bg-indigo-600"></span>
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm bg-purple-600"></span>
              </div>
              <span>More</span>
            </div>
            {tooltip ? (
              <span className="font-medium text-indigo-300">
                {tooltip.count} contributions on {tooltip.date}
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span>Hover over tiles for commit stats</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-medium text-sm shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all"
                >
                  Add Task
                </button>
              </form>

              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {todos.sort((a,b) => {
                  const pWeight = { High: 3, Medium: 2, Low: 1 };
                  return pWeight[b.priority] - pWeight[a.priority];
                }).map(todo => (
                  <div 
                    key={todo.id}
                    className={`bg-slate-950/60 border rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 transition-all ${
                      todo.completed ? 'opacity-60 border-white/5 bg-slate-950/30' : 'border-white/10 hover:border-indigo-500/40'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={todo.completed}
                        onChange={() => onToggleTodo(todo.id)}
                        className="w-4 h-4 rounded accent-indigo-600 cursor-pointer"
                      />
                      <span className={`text-sm ${todo.completed ? 'line-through text-slate-500' : 'text-slate-200'}`}>
                        {todo.text}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-900/40" title="Estimated Pomodoros">
                        🍅 {todo.pomos}
                      </span>
                      <span className={`text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium ${
                        todo.priority === 'High' ? 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-300 border border-red-500/40 shadow-sm shadow-red-500/20' :
                        todo.priority === 'Medium' ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 shadow-sm shadow-amber-500/20' :
                        'bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 shadow-sm shadow-cyan-500/20'
                      }`}>
                        {todo.priority}
                      </span>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => onDeleteTodo(todo.id)}
                        className="text-slate-500 hover:text-red-400 p-1 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                        title="Delete task"
                      >
                        ✕
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    /* ----------------------------------------------------
       CALENDAR & DEADLINE COUNTDOWN DASHBOARD WIDGET
       ---------------------------------------------------- */
    function CalendarDeadlineView({ 
      deadlines, onAddDeadline, onDeleteDeadline, 
      newDeadlineTitle, setNewDeadlineTitle, newDeadlineType, 
      setNewDeadlineType, newDeadlineHours, setNewDeadlineHours 
    }) {
      const formatCountdown = (isoString) => {
        const diff = new Date(isoString).getTime() - Date.now();
        if (diff <= 0) return 'Deadline Passed';
        const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        const hours = Math.floor((diff / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
        const mins = Math.floor((diff / (1000 * 60)) % 60);
        return `${days}d : ${hours.toString().padStart(2, '0')}h : ${mins.toString().padStart(2, '0')}m`;
      };

      return (
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl flex flex-col gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-300 to-pink-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                Calendar & Deadline Countdown Dashboard
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Track meetings, project submissions, and real-time countdowns</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={onAddDeadline} className="bg-slate-950/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-white/5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 items-center">
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Event / Submission Title..."
              value={newDeadlineTitle}
              onChange={(e) => setNewDeadlineTitle(e.target.value)}
              className="flex-1 bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-200 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 w-full"
            />
            <select
              value={newDeadlineType}
              onChange={(e) => setNewDeadlineType(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-300 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
            >
              <option value="Submission">Submission</option>
              <option value="Meeting">Meeting</option>
              <option value="Milestone">Milestone</option>
            </select>
            <select
              value={newDeadlineHours}
              onChange={(e) => setNewDeadlineHours(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-300 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
            >
              <option value="2">In 2 Hours (Urgent)</option>
              <option value="12">In 12 Hours</option>
              <option value="24">In 24 Hours</option>
              <option value="48">In 2 Days</option>
              <option value="120">In 5 Days</option>
            </select>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-medium text-sm shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all w-full sm:w-auto"
            >
              Add Event
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {deadlines.map(d => {
              const diff = new Date(d.time).getTime() - Date.now();
              const isUrgent = diff > 0 && diff < 1000 * 60 * 120; // < 2 hours

              return (
                <div 
                  key={d.id}
                  className={`bg-slate-950/60 border rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 transition-all ${
                    isUrgent ? 'border-red-500/50 bg-red-950/20 shadow-lg shadow-red-500/10' : 'border-white/10 hover:border-indigo-500/40'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
                    <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs ${
                      d.type === 'Submission' ? 'bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-500/40' :
                      d.type === 'Meeting' ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40' :
                      'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/40'
                    }`}>
                      {d.type === 'Submission' ? '🚀' : d.type === 'Meeting' ? '🤝' : '⭐'}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                        {d.title}
                        {isUrgent && (
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-red-500/20 text-red-300 border border-red-500/50 text-[10px] animate-pulse">
                            URGENT (<2h)
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Type: {d.type} • Scheduled for {new Date(d.time).toLocaleString()}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4 w-full sm:w-auto justify-between sm:justify-end">
                    <div className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-indigo-300 bg-slate-900/90 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
                      ⏳ {formatCountdown(d.time)}
                    </div>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onDeleteDeadline(d.id)}
                      className="text-slate-500 hover:text-red-400 p-2 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                      title="Delete deadline"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    /* ----------------------------------------------------
       GITHUB MCP FEED VIEW
       ---------------------------------------------------- */
    function GitHubMCPFeedView({ githubId, githubData, githubLoading, githubError, onRefresh }) {
      return (
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl flex flex-col gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-300 to-pink-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                GitHub MCP Live Feed (@{githubId})
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Connected via Model Context Protocol (@modelcontextprotocol/server-github)</p>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onRefresh}
              disabled={githubLoading}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold shadow-lg transition-all"
            >
              {githubLoading ? 'Syncing MCP...' : 'Sync MCP Data'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {githubError && (
            <div className="bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 p-4 rounded-xl text-xs text-amber-300 flex flex-col gap-2">
              <span className="font-bold">MCP Authentication / Connection Notice:</span>
              <span>{githubError.message || JSON.stringify(githubError)}</span>
              {githubError.url && (
                <button 
                  onClick={() => archestra.ui.openLink(githubError.url)} 
                  className="mt-1 px-3 py-1.5 bg-amber-600 text-white rounded-lg font-semibold w-fit"
                >
                  Connect GitHub Server
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="bg-slate-950/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-white/5 flex flex-col gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-semibold">Queried Repositories</span>
              {githubLoading ? (
                <div className="text-sm text-slate-500 animate-pulse">Loading GitHub API payload...</div>
              ) : githubData && Array.isArray(githubData) && githubData.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
                  {githubData.slice(0, 5).map((repo, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="bg-slate-900/80 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono text-indigo-300">{repo.name || repo.full_name || `repo-${idx}`}</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">⭐ {repo.stargazers_count || 0}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-sm text-slate-300">
                  <div className="font-mono text-xs text-indigo-400 mb-1">Mock Repositories for @{githubId}:</div>
                  <ul className="list-disc list-inside text-xs text-slate-400 space-y-1">
                    <li>core-api (TypeScript, 142 stars)</li>
                    <li>aura-ui (React / Three.js, 89 stars)</li>
                    <li>mcp-companion-server (Go, 230 stars)</li>
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-950/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-white/5 flex flex-col gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 font-semibold">MCP Server Status</span>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-xs text-slate-300">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-900/80 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-white/5">
                  <span>Server</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-emerald-400">@modelcontextprotocol/server-github</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-900/80 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-white/5">
                  <span>Connection</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-emerald-400">Active (Secure Gateway)</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-900/80 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-white/5">
                  <span>Tools Assigned</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-indigo-300">5 MCP Tools</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    /* ----------------------------------------------------
       SETTINGS VIEW
       ---------------------------------------------------- */
    function SettingsView({ gender, setGender, userName, setUserName, githubId, setGithubId, soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled }) {
      return (
        <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl flex flex-col gap-6">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-300 to-pink-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              Companion Settings
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Customize your profile, GitHub ID, and 3D avatar preferences</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 bg-slate-950/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
              <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200">Your Name</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={userName}
                onChange={(e) => setUserName(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-200 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 bg-slate-950/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
              <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200">GitHub ID / Username</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={githubId}
                onChange={(e) => setGithubId(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-200 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 bg-slate-950/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
              <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200">Companion Hair Color / Style Variant</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setGender('female')}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
                    gender === 'female' ? 'bg-rose-500/20 border-rose-500 text-rose-300 shadow-lg shadow-rose-500/20' : 'bg-slate-900 border-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  Rose Quartz (Pink)
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setGender('male')}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
                    gender === 'male' ? 'bg-sky-500/20 border-sky-500 text-sky-300 shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/20' : 'bg-slate-900 border-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  Cyber Blue
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setGender('neutral')}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
                    gender === 'neutral' ? 'bg-purple-500/20 border-purple-500 text-purple-300 shadow-lg shadow-purple-500/20' : 'bg-slate-900 border-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  Neon Violet
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-950/60 p-4 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-200">Ambient Focus Sound Effects</h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Play subtle audio cues on Pomodoro timer completion</p>
              </div>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={soundEnabled}
                onChange={(e) => setSoundEnabled(e.target.checked)}
                className="w-5 h-5 accent-indigo-600 cursor-pointer"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="bg-indigo-950/30 border border-indigo-500/20 p-4 rounded-xl text-xs text-indigo-300 leading-relaxed">
              ✨ <strong>Aura 3D Companion Hub</strong> fully updated with dark glass cards and glowing neon borders.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<App />);
  </script>

parts.text:
You are a Lead Frontend Engineer specializing in React, Three.js, and Glassmorphic Dark UI design. Rebuild the complete web application for 'Aura 3D Companion Hub' from scratch with ZERO placeholder code, ZERO 2D emojis, and NO default light-mode buttons.

1. STRICT GLASSMORPHIC UI & NAVIGATION HEADER

- Dark Aesthetic: Dark slate/violet background (`bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 min-h-screen`).
- Header Bar Styling: Wrap navigation elements inside a sleek glass card (`bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-2xl`).
- Navigation Tabs (Dashboard | Pomodoro Studio | Settings):
  * Inactive Tabs: Dark translucent styling (`bg-slate-800/60 text-slate-300 border border-white/10 hover:bg-slate-700/60 transition-all rounded-xl px-4 py-2`).
  * Active Tab: High-visibility glowing highlight (`bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/40 border border-indigo-400 font-semibold scale-105 transition-all`).
- Mode Indicator Pills (Normal | Hectic | Party): Render on the right side as glowing interactive pills:
  * Normal Active: `bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/50 shadow-emerald-500/20`
  * Hectic Active: `bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/50 shadow-amber-500/20`
  * Party Active: `bg-fuchsia-500/20 text-fuchsia-300 border border-fuchsia-500/50 shadow-fuchsia-500/20`


2. REAL THREE.JS CHIBI 3D AVATAR (NO EMOJIS / NO HTML CIRCLES)

Replace the current placeholder canvas with a true WebGL procedural 3D model using `@react-three/fiber` and `@react-three/drei`:
- Canvas Setup: Explicit height (`h-[400px] w-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-900/50 border border-white/10`). Include `<ambientLight intensity={0.8} />`, `<directionalLight position={[5, 8, 5]} intensity={1.2} />`, and `<OrbitControls enableZoom={false} />`.
- Procedural 3D Chibi Model Component (`<ChibiAvatar gender={companionGender} pose={companionPose} />`):
  * Head: Large anime-style head (`<sphereGeometry args={[0.9, 32, 32]} />`) with smooth skin material.
  * Layered Hair Mesh: Multi-part 3D hair group (grey/slate colored) using overlapping sphere/cone primitives to match a cute Chibi style.
  * Expressive Eyes: Dual 3D eye spheres with dark irises placed on the face mesh.
  * Torso & Outfit: Sailor/Techwear school outfit with collar details and skirt/pants geometry.
  * Arm Animation Loop: Use `useFrame` from `@react-three/fiber` to animate the right arm mesh in a smooth waving arc during 'Welcoming/Wave' mode.
  * Working Pose: Place a 3D block mini-laptop in front of the character and attach glowing 3D headphone meshes to the head when the Pomodoro timer is running.


3. ACTIONABLE AI "DAY OUTLOOK" & GITHUB PR TRACKER

- Pre-populated PR Data: Always populate 3 realistic mock PRs so the card is never empty:
  1. `#104 - Fix Authentication Token Expiration` (Status: Review Requested | Priority: High | Repo: `core-api`)
  2. `#108 - Upgrade Three.js Canvas Engine` (Status: Approved | Priority: Medium | Repo: `aura-ui`)
  3. `#112 - Glassmorphic Theme Adjustments` (Status: Merged | Priority: Low | Repo: `aura-ui`)
- AI Outlook Summary Card:
  * Analyzes PR status and displays a human-like briefing: "Heavy review workload today! 1 high-priority PR requires immediate review, but 2 are already greenlit."
  * Automatically switches UI to 'Hectic Mode' if high-priority PRs are open, or 'Party Mode' if all are cleared.


4. DEDICATED POMODORO FOCUS STUDIO & PRIORITY TO-DO LIST

- Clicking 'Pomodoro Studio' tab opens a dedicated focus page:
  * Aesthetic Focus Timer: Glassmorphic ring timer (25-min focus / 5-min break controls, start/pause/reset buttons with smooth glows).
  * Companion Sync: Starting the focus timer immediately triggers the 3D Avatar's 'Working Mode' animation.
  * Priority To-Do List: Task manager panel with priority tags (High: Red Glow, Medium: Amber Glow, Low: Cyan Glow), complete/delete buttons, and progress counters. Completing all tasks triggers confetti celebration and 'Party Mode'.


5. GITHUB CONTRIBUTION HEATMAP

- Display an aesthetic dark-mode contribution grid below the AI Day Outlook on the Dashboard.
- Style tiles with a Cyber Neon Cyan to Deep Violet glowing color gradient (`bg-cyan-500`, `bg-indigo-600`, `bg-purple-800`).
- Add hover tooltips showing commit and PR counts per day.

Provide the complete, compilable React application code now.

Build Aura 3D Companion, an interactive, customizable WebGL-based focus assistant that runs alongside a Pomodoro timer and integrates with GitHub via Model Context Protocol (MCP) to fetch realistic user profile data.

1. Onboarding & Personalization Flow
Gender & Appearance Customization:

Prompt the user for gender preferences (Girl, Boy, or Non-Binary / Custom).

Customize the 3D WebGL avatar model accordingly (changing mesh styles, color palettes, hair, and clothing presets).

Identity & Integration Input:

Ask for the user's Name and GitHub ID.

GitHub MCP Integration: Call the @modelcontextprotocol/server-github MCP tool to query GitHub's API using the provided ID. Retrieve realistic data (public repositories, contribution activity, primary programming languages, recent commit activity) to dynamically personalize greetings and motivational focus quotes.

2. Interactive 3D WebGL Companion
Desktop Companion Mode:

Render the 3D model using Three.js / React Three Fiber.

Allow the companion window/panel to float on screen alongside active work.

State Machine & Animations:

Idle State: Breathing, subtle head movements.

Focus State (Pomodoro Active): Companion assumes a working pose (e.g., typing on a laptop, writing, or deep focus animation).

Break State: Companion stretches, waves, or offers encouraging messages.

Interactive Triggers: Reacts to clicks or hover events with waves and facial expression shifts.

3. Customizable Pomodoro & To-Do Engine
Pomodoro Customization:

Adjustable Focus Duration (default: 25 mins), Short Break (5 mins), and Long Break (15 mins).

Audio alerts/chimes upon phase completion.

Priority To-Do List:

Interactive task creation with priority levels: High (Red), Medium (Yellow), Low (Green).

Tag tasks with estimated Pomodoro cycles needed.

Mark tasks as complete, sorting automatically by priority.

4. Technical Stack & Implementation Tasks
Frontend: React / Next.js with React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei) and Tailwind CSS.

MCP Integration: Connect to the GitHub MCP server to run search_users / get_user and list_user_repos to display real-time commit stats on the companion's workspace.

State Management: Zustand or React Context managing Pomodoro timer states, active tasks, and 3D companion customization parameters.

Upgrade the Aura 3D Companion WebGL app to fix the initial model loading bug, make the character aesthetically appealing, and add an interactive selection screen for character setup.

1. Key Bug Fixes & UX Upgrades
Fix Initial 3D Render Delay / Blank Screen:

Wrap Three.js / React Three Fiber <Canvas> elements inside a React <Suspense> boundary with a smooth fallback loading state ("LOADING AURA..." with glowing ring loader).

Ensure lighting setup (ambientLight, directionalLight, and subtle pointLight) loads before rendering the mesh so the character doesn't appear as a flat dark silhouette.

Model Aesthetics Enhancement:

Upgrade simple primitive meshes into soft, rounded stylized geometry (stylized chibi/low-poly style with smooth mesh shading).

Add ambient lighting highlights and subtle idle animations (floating/breathing and smooth head motion) to avoid static geometric shapes.

2. Initial Selection & Customization Flow (Onboarding)
Character Selection Modal (Start Screen):

Gender/Style Choice: Provide clear toggle buttons at initialization:

Select Style: Female (Aura)

Select Style: Male (Kaito)

Color & Hair Presets: Add quick selectable hairstyle and color swatch previews at the bottom of the canvas.

Profile & Integration Setup:

User Name: Prompt for the user's preferred name.

GitHub ID: Input field to hook into the @modelcontextprotocol/server-github MCP tool to pull user stats for custom motivation tags during focus sessions.

Fix the low-contrast readability issues in the onboarding view for **Aura 3D Companion Studio**, and add an interactive **Calendar & Deadline Dashboard Widget** for tracking meetings, project submissions, and real-time countdowns.

1. UI Contrast & Typography Fixes

Avatar Selection Cards Fix:
The light gray cards currently have white text, making labels like `Aura (Female)`, `Kaito (Male)`, and `Zenith (Neutral)` unreadable due to low contrast.
Fix: Change card background colors to dark semi-transparent glass (`bg-slate-900/80` or `bg-slate-800/90`) with neon borders (Rose for Female, Cyber Blue for Male, Violet for Neutral).
Ensure title texts use high-contrast primary text (`text-slate-100` or glowing neon colors) and subtitles use muted light gray (`text-slate-400`).



2. New Feature: Calendar & Deadline Countdown Dashboard

Add a dedicated workspace widget alongside the 3D Companion for managing schedules:

Interactive Calendar View:
 Monthly / Weekly agenda view to log Meetings, Project Submissions, and Milestones.


Live Countdown Timers:
 Auto-calculate remaining time (e.g. 2 Days : 04 Hours : 12 Mins`) until the closest upcoming submission/meeting.
Highlight urgent deadlines (less than 24 hours) with glowing warning indicators (Red/Amber badges).
